headlines.title: 中国央行7月公开市场国债买卖净投放500亿元
headlines.summary: 央行公布2026年7月各项工具流动性投放情况，中央银行贷款方面，常备借贷便利（SLF）净回笼10亿元；中期借贷便利（MLF）净投放1000亿元，抵押补充贷款（PSL）净回笼1161亿元；公开市场业务方面，7天期逆回购净投放2495亿元，公开国债买卖净投放500亿元；中央国库现金管理净投放300亿元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC injects net 50 billion yuan via open market government bond operations in July
headlines.summary_en: PBOC releases July 2026 liquidity injection details: Standing Lending Facility (SLF) saw a net withdrawal of 1 billion yuan; Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) saw a net injection of 100 billion yuan; Pledged Supplementary Lending (PSL) saw a net withdrawal of 116.1 billion yuan. In open market operations, 7-day reverse repos saw a net injection of 249.5 billion yuan, open market government bond trading saw a net injection of 5 billion yuan, and central treasury cash management saw a net injection of 3 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 中国央行：8月5日将开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月
headlines.summary: 为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年8月5日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月（92天），到期日为2026年11月5日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: PBOC: 500 billion yuan outright reverse repos with 3-month tenor to be conducted on August 5
headlines.summary_en: To maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, on August 5, 2026, the People's Bank of China will conduct a 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation with fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award, with a term of 3 months (92 days), maturing on November 5, 2026 (postponed in case of holidays).

headlines.summary_en: China Railway Construction Corporation (01186.HK) announced that its cumulative new contracts signed this year totaled 878.158 billion yuan, down 16.85% year-on-year. Engineering contracting new contracts amounted to 650.648 billion yuan, down 17.48%; green environmental protection 95.385 billion yuan, down 11.17%; planning, design and consulting 7.556 billion yuan, down 24.93%; industrial manufacturing 17.61 billion yuan, up 8.59%; real estate development 27.237 billion yuan, down 25.95%; materials and logistics 68.267 billion yuan, down 20.07%; industrial finance 3.589 billion yuan, down 11.00%; emerging industries 7.867 billion yuan, up 0.11%.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: July property market remains resilient despite off-season: multiple cities see year-on-year transaction growth, Shanghai luxury project sells out on launch day
headlines.summary_en: In July, due to high temperatures and traditional off-season factors, property transactions in key cities weakened month-on-month, but remained resilient compared to the same period last year, with many cities seeing year-on-year growth in new home and second-hand home transactions. Shanghai's core-area high-end renovation properties performed notably, with luxury projects selling out on launch day.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount bonds (47th tranche) with a tender face value totaling 20 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry discount bond (47th issue). This bond is a 28-day discount bond. The competitive bidding face value totals 20 billion yuan, with Class A members eligible for additional bidding. The issuance price will be determined through competitive bidding, issued at a discount below face value. Interest accrues from August 6, 2026, with repayment at face value on September 3, 2026 (postponed in case of holidays). Bidding time is from 10:35 to 11:35 a.m. on August 5, 2026.

headlines.title: China’s manufacturing sector falters in July as growth momentum cools
headlines.summary:
China’s factory activity has slipped into contraction in July, ending a four-month growth streak as weaker new orders and persistent demand challenges highlight the need for further policy support from Beijing, analysts said.
The manufacturing purchasing managers’ index (PMI) fell to 49.2 in July, down from 50.3 in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Friday. The reading fell short of the 50.11 projection from economists polled by the financial data...
headlines.title_zh: 中国制造业7月动能降温，增长势头放缓
headlines.summary_zh: 分析师表示，中国7月工厂活动陷入收缩，结束了连续四个月的增长态势，新订单疲软和持续的需求挑战凸显出北京方面需要进一步加大政策支持力度。数据显示，7月制造业采购经理指数（PMI）从6月的50.3降至49.2。

headlines.title: Chinese families turn to cash and cautious stock bets as real estate avenues narrow
headlines.summary:
Chinese families are fast retreating from real estate, with many holding large cash reserves now cautiously weighing stock investments, marking a stark contrast with South Korea, where retail investors are aggressively using leverage to fuel equity bets at home and abroad.
Property’s share of household assets dropped to 52 per cent in the first quarter of 2026 from 67 per cent in mid-2021, while cash and bank deposits rose to 25 per cent from 16 per cent in the same period, according to a...
headlines.title_zh: 中国家庭转向现金和谨慎的股票押注，房地产渠道收窄
headlines.summary_zh: 中国家庭正快速撤离房地产市场，许多家庭持有大量现金，如今谨慎考虑股票投资，这与韩国形成鲜明对比——韩国散户投资者正积极利用杠杆在国内和海外市场进行股票押注。第一季度，房地产占家庭资产的比例降至52%。

headlines.title: 市场监管总局召开深入贯彻落实公平竞争审查制度专项行动推进会
headlines.summary: 7月28日，市场监管总局在北京召开深入贯彻落实公平竞争审查制度专项行动推进会，听取有关地方工作进展情况，总结阶段性工作成效，部署推动下一阶段重点工作任务。总局党组成员、副局长孟扬出席会议并讲话。 专项行动围绕加快构建全国统一大市场，坚持问题导向，聚焦基层开展公平竞争审查存在的问题，针对性部署15项具体任务，指导各地结合实际扎实推进，取得阶段性工作成效，为公平竞争审查落地见效提供了有力保障。

headlines.title_en: SAMR holds meeting to advance special campaign on implementing fair competition review system
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a promotion meeting in Beijing for the special campaign to deeply implement the fair competition review system, hearing progress reports from relevant local authorities, summarizing phased achievements, and deploying key tasks for the next stage. Deputy Director of the Party Group and Deputy Administrator Meng Yang attended and spoke. The campaign focuses on accelerating the construction of a unified national market, adhering to a problem-oriented approach, targeting issues in grassroots fair competition review, and deploying 15 specific tasks to guide local implementation, achieving phased results that provide strong support for the effective implementation of fair competition review.

headlines.title: 工信部：对于L3级自动驾驶系统应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能
headlines.summary: 《智能网联汽车 自动驾驶系统安全要求》强制性国家标准正式发布。拟于2027年7月1日起正式实施。其中提到，该标准立足我国产业发展与行业监管实际需求，兼顾技术可行性、产业适配性与落地实操性，构建了维度完整、要求清晰、适配国情的安全要求体系。规范人机交互与用户告知要求，防范误用滥用风险。标准要求自动驾驶系统的激活和退出过程应安全，并明确就绪、激活、退出等状态信息及信号的提示规范。对于L3级自动驾驶系统还应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: L3-level autonomous driving systems should include driver takeover capability monitoring functions
headlines.summary_en: The mandatory national standard 'Safety Requirements for Automated Driving Systems of Intelligent Connected Vehicles' has been officially released, scheduled to take effect on July 1, 2027. The standard, based on China's industry development and regulatory needs, balances technical feasibility, industrial adaptability, and practical implementation, building a comprehensive and clear safety requirement system adapted to national conditions. It regulates human-machine interaction and user notification requirements to prevent misuse and abuse risks. The standard requires that activation and deactivation of automated driving systems be safe, with clear specifications for status information and signals related to readiness, activation, and deactivation. For L3 automated driving systems, driver takeover capability monitoring functions are required.

headlines.summary: 8月4日，证监会网站显示，中欧基金正式申报中欧中证机器人ETF，这是其旗下首只ETF产品。至此，非货币基金规模排名前20的基金公司已全部布局ETF市场。业内人士认为，中欧基金此举或是在为参与主动ETF市场竞争“蓄力”。（人民财讯）

headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the CSRC website showed that Zhongou Fund formally filed for the Zhongou CSI Robot ETF, its first ETF product. With this, all top 20 fund companies by non-money fund scale have entered the ETF market. Industry insiders believe Zhongou Fund's move may be preparing for competition in the active ETF market. headlines.title: 路透：特朗普政府正起草针对中国数据中心设备的禁令
headlines.summary: 据路透消息，特朗普政府正在起草一项禁令，禁止美国进口中国生产的新款数据中心零部件。负责监管美国电信行业的联邦通信委员会正在着手制定相关措施，禁止进口新型中国光收发器，这种设备能让数据在数据中心内通过光缆以光速传输。官员们希望能在今年内公布这项措施，届时将正式生效。

headlines.title_en: Reuters: Trump administration drafting ban on Chinese data center equipment
headlines.summary_en: According to Reuters, the Trump administration is drafting a ban prohibiting U.S. imports of new data center components made in China. The Federal Communications Commission, which oversees the U.S. telecom industry, is working on measures to ban imports of new Chinese optical transceivers, devices that enable data transmission at light speed via fiber optics within data centers. Officials hope to announce the measure within this year, at which point it will take effect.

headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部装备工业一司8月4日组织道路机动车辆检验检测机构开展座谈，分析当前产品安全和检验检测工作形势，部署规范道路机动车辆检验检测行业竞争秩序、提升检验检测工作质量相关工作。会议要求，道路机动车辆检验检测机构要深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，坚决抵制非理性竞争，严把产品检测关。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Strengthen identification and testing verification of risks from 'radical' innovative designs in road motor vehicle products; enhance safety assessment of combined driving assistance and autonomous driving functions
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the First Equipment Industry Department of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology organized a symposium with road motor vehicle inspection and testing institutions to analyze the current situation of product safety and inspection work, and deploy efforts to regulate competition order in the road vehicle inspection industry and improve inspection quality. The meeting required these institutions to fully implement the decisions of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, resolutely resist irrational competition, and strictly uphold product testing standards.
